about: Ceilings in seconds for each CI job, checked by .github/scripts/check-ci-budgets.py after every run. Set about 10% above the slowest of 150 runs (2026-11-13 to 11-16), so a run goes red on a regression, not on a slow runner; targets says where each should end up. Lower a budget when a job gets faster; raise one only in the PR that makes the job slower, and say why.
setupSteps: Check whether the change reaches this job
Set up pnpm and install dependencies
